title: MOASYS-Vault — output/plex/logs-summary.json
description: Every distinct ERROR and WARN problem in the Plex server and scanner logs, grouped by signature. Generated by `npm run plex:logs`. Timestamps inside are the server's local time as Plex writes them (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm`, no zone).

generated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the file was written.

log_files.description: Log files read from the archive, e.g. `Plex Media Server.1.log`.

covers.description: Server-local time of the first and last problem line. Null when the logs held none.

tied_to_library.description: Lines tied to a file or folder in a configured library.

unknown_items.description: Lines naming an item id the last `plex:pull` doesn't have.

problems.description: Most frequent first; ties by signature.

log.description: Log the lines came from, without rotation number, e.g. `Plex Media Server`, `Plex Media Scanner Analysis`.

component.description: Leading `[Component]` tag with request ids removed, e.g. `CreditsDetectionManager`.

signature.description: The message with request ids, numbers (`N`), paths (`<path>`), guids (`<guids>`), and long hex runs (`<hex>`) generalized.

tied_to_library.description: How many of these lines were tied to a library file or folder.

sample.description: First line of the first occurrence, trimmed to 240 characters. May include local IP addresses and the Plex username.
